verdict.rationale: No data-export or account-portability feature is documented. The closest evidence is per-record retrieval through the API: GET endpoints return incorporation details, and the tax-registration endpoint lets you poll status and download the generated ELSTER XML (an open format). That gives only a piecemeal API workaround for getting data out, not a way to export everything and leave. Missing for 10: a bulk or full-account export, coverage of all data types (notarized documents, translations, signers, apostilles), documented open export formats beyond tax XML, offboarding/deletion guidance, and independent corroboration.
